verses.pali: “Idhāhaṁ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṁ nicchaviṁ itthiṁ vehāsaṁ gacchantiṁ.
verses.english: “Just now, reverend, as I was descending from Vulture’s Peak Mountain I saw a flayed woman flying through the air.

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ gijjhāpi kākāpi kulalāpi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitacchenti virājenti.
verses.english: Vultures, crows, and hawks kept chasing her, pecking and clawing

verses.pali: esā, bhikkhave, itthī imasmiṁyeva rājagahe aticārinī ahosi …pe….
verses.english: “That woman used to be an adulteress right here in Rājagaha. …”
